slot_fields.raw_answer_path: actual final.txt or PUBLIC_FINAL.txt in the current consumer
slot_fields.answer: claims actually present in the final, using the public ANSWER_SCHEMA field names
slot_fields.answer_excerpt: exact nonempty contiguous final text containing the structured answer

claim_support.field: asserted JSON path or extra assertion

slot_fields.region_reason_codes: identity->reason code, normalized only from an explicit final reason; no truth fill
slot_fields.extra_assertions: all additional substantive claims with exact final excerpts and disposition

claims.final_use_excerpt: same task fact actually used in final
claims.source_reference_excerpt: actual current source reference used in final

process_diagnostics.source_support: exact current request/output excerpts for all classified attempts

requirements: All six slots, including failure and not-run, remain in the denominator.
Current sources and raw final are bound before claims are scored.
No missing fact, identity, source or reason is filled from administrator truth.
Entire final and all unretracted extras receive independent semantic review before quality scoring.
Source quotation proves provenance; semantic entailment is reviewed independently.
No cost ranking or usage is read before quality seal.
